item.title: December 1.0 (112)
item.description:
## What's new
- **Archives open like folders.** Zip, tar (plain or gzip/bzip2/xz/zstd) and 7z open in the pane with the usual sidebar, breadcrumbs and back/forward, and stepping out puts the cursor back on the archive. Zip and tar are writable: create folders and files, rename, delete and drag files in; 7z stays read-only. - **Git lives in the status bar.** The branch chip names the current branch and tints it by status. Its menu shows tracking (`main · ↑2 ↓1`), local and remote branches grouped by remote — read-only, nothing is checked out — opens the repository on GitHub, copies the remote URL or commit SHA, fetches, and can fast-forward pull after a confirmation. - **F4 and Open With work again.** December no longer forwards an inherited shell variable that made VS Code and other Electron apps exit a fraction of a second after opening a file. - **⌘J follows a downloaded archive after it expands.** The folder the browser turned the archive into counts as the arrival, including app packages and slow expansions, instead of jumping to the previous download.
